exposure: lobectomy within 30 days after birth (early = EAG)
CVR of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformations (CCAM)
congenital pulmonary airway malformation volume ratio (CVR) of bronchial atresia (BA)
timing of surgery (emergent, urgent, early, late)

cohort: 36 infants prenatally diagnosed with congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM) from 2009 through 2014
